rationale: ModernTCN survived first-shot (W2 PASS @ thr=0.0 50% WR / +7.1% ann; W1 narrow miss thr=0.6 +17.5% ann) but the CPU wall blew up on splits 5-7. Pin {num_blocks=1, dims=32, batch_size=512} for wall-time safety and let train_mode sweep epochs ∈ [10, 25], pos_weight ∈ [1.0, 1.8], dropout ∈ [0.0, 0.3], head_dropout ∈ [0.0, 0.3], learning_rate ∈ [3e-4, 3e-3] one-at-a-time. Per [[timesfm-pos-weight-2-regresses]] keep pos_weight ≤ 1.5; the score-collapse on splits 3-4 (thr=0.0 dominates) is the same calibration symptom seen in iter #2849 CARD and is the priority axis for the sweep.
